default.notes: Apply online at visas.immigration.go.ug before travel (USD 50 single entry, stays up to 90 days); the approval letter is exchanged for the visa on arrival. A yellow fever certificate is required from all travellers.

groups.notes: East African Community citizens enter Uganda freely under the common market protocol — Kenyan and Rwandan nationals can even cross on national ID cards, and stays of up to 6 months are granted.

On Uganda's visa-exemption list, which covers a number of African, Caribbean and Commonwealth countries — no visa is needed for visits of up to about 90 days; the list changes periodically, so confirm on visas.immigration.go.ug before travel.

UG.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Ugandan citizens.
